_comment: Global emergency red flags. Each flag fires from regex 'patterns' on the patient's own words, 'patterns_all' (every regex in a group must match), and/or a 'when' condition on extracted facts. Negations such as 'no chest pain' are handled in code. REVIEW EVERY ENTRY WITH A CLINICIAN BEFORE REAL USE.

extra_facts.question: Any difficulty breathing?
extra_facts.description: True if the person has trouble breathing or cannot get enough air.

extra_facts.question: Any chest pain?
extra_facts.description: True if chest pain, pressure or tightness is present.

extra_facts.question: Are you sweating heavily, or feeling sick or light-headed with it?
extra_facts.description: True if cold sweat or heavy unexplained sweating.

extra_facts.question: Does the pain spread to your arm, shoulder, jaw or back?
extra_facts.description: True if chest pain spreads to arm, shoulder, jaw or back.

extra_facts.question: Does it feel like heavy pressure or tightness?
extra_facts.description: True if described as crushing, squeezing or heavy.

extra_facts.question: Any fever?
extra_facts.description: True if the person has or had a fever.

extra_facts.question: Any vomiting?
extra_facts.description: True if vomiting.

extra_facts.question: Any new confusion, unusual drowsiness or trouble staying awake?
extra_facts.description: True if new confusion or drowsiness.

extra_facts.question: Has the person fainted or blacked out?
extra_facts.description: True if fainted, collapsed or was unresponsive.

extra_facts.question: Any sudden weakness or numbness on one side, face drooping, trouble speaking, or sudden vision loss?
extra_facts.description: True for any stroke-type sign.

extra_facts.question: Is one side of the face drooping?
extra_facts.description: True if facial droop.

extra_facts.question: Is there sudden weakness or numbness in an arm or leg, especially on one side?
extra_facts.description: True if sudden limb weakness or numbness.

extra_facts.question: Is speech slurred or confused?
extra_facts.description: True if slurred or difficult speech.

extra_facts.question: Any sudden loss of vision?
extra_facts.description: True if sudden vision loss.

extra_facts.question: Is there heavy bleeding that will not stop?
extra_facts.description: True if severe or uncontrolled bleeding.

extra_facts.question: Are you vomiting blood or passing black tarry stools?
extra_facts.description: True if blood in vomit or black tarry stool.

extra_facts.question: Are you coughing up blood?
extra_facts.description: True if coughing up blood.

extra_facts.question: Has there been a seizure or fit?
extra_facts.description: True if seizure or convulsion.

extra_facts.question: Any swelling of the tongue or throat, or a feeling the throat is closing?
extra_facts.description: True if tongue or throat swelling.

extra_facts.question: Are you having thoughts of harming yourself or ending your life?
extra_facts.description: True if the person expresses thoughts of suicide or self-harm.

extra_facts.question: Has anything poisonous or too many tablets been swallowed?
extra_facts.description: True if poisoning or overdose.

extra_facts.question: Any new rash or purple spots that do not fade when pressed with a glass?
extra_facts.description: True if non-blanching rash.

patterns: (can'?t|cannot|can not|unable to|struggling to|hard to|difficult to) breathe
